$spaceNote: 4pt base. Screen gutter = space.5 (16). Section rhythm = space.8 (32). Card padding = space.5.
$radiusNote: sm(8) for chips and inputs, lg(16) for cards, 2xl(28) for sheets, pill for all primary/secondary buttons — the pill button is inherited from troyestore.com.
$elevationNote: Shadows are ink-tinted, never pure black. Dark theme replaces elevation with surface lightening (bg.surface -> bg.raised) plus a hairline border.
